in_scope: England CQC-registered homecare (personal care) process cross-checks only. People's experience and observation are listed as not testable from operational exports. This corpus does not produce CQC ratings.
gaps_explicit: Loaded extracts do not state a care-plan review interval in days or months.
Loaded extracts do not include an official needs-to-service mapping table.
People's experience and observation are CQC evidence categories that operational CSV/XLSX visit and invoice extracts cannot supply.
Loaded extracts confirm CQC ratings exist as CQC's approach; this product does not emit those ratings as grades.
